hot_week.label: Hot-week incident solar radiation
hot_week.meaning: Incident solar energy per square metre of envelope surface; not temperature or indoor cooling load.

annual.label: Annual incident solar radiation
annual.meaning: Incident solar energy per square metre of envelope surface; not temperature or indoor cooling load.

provenance.basis: Organiser-exported baseline Ladybug solar radiation, not a new calculation of the current edited design.

coordinateAlignment.coordinateSystem: Same Rhino model coordinates; metres; Z up; no transform/rotation applied.
coordinateAlignment.method: Nearest triangle distance to current uploaded-model skin meshes for deterministic evenly spread face-centroid sample, accounting for the official 0.15m outward lift. This is a coordinate alignment check, not a full rerun or proof of unchanged radiation under edits.

provenance.precision: Supplied exporter rounds geometry to0.01m and radiation to0.1kWh/m²; values are preserved exactly.
provenance.exportEvidence: The supplied export script reads the hot-week component mesh and per-face results directly from the four Ladybug Incident Radiation component outputs. The source radiation JSON has no EVAL ID or calculation timestamp.

limitations: Baseline exterior envelope only; hide this overlay whenever geometry transforms are present.
Incident solar radiation in kWh/m², not air/surface temperature in°C or spatial comfort.
No solar reflections between surfaces are modelled; the Ladybug component uses a crude ground-reflection hemisphere.
This baseline radiation field is independent of glazing g/U and ventilation inputs; it does not update when those controls change.
Analysis faces were lifted0.15m outward by the official loader; display coordinates already include this offset.
